card.name: Spots right before think or thoughts
card.fires_on: Words just before the model expects think, thought or thoughts, such as 'my' in 'in my humble prayers', 'to' in 'comes to mind', or 'can' in 'can think of'. Also fires on the word think itself in 'think of a ...' prompts.

modes.label: Slot before thinking words
modes.description: A small word where the next word is likely think, thoughts or thinking.
modes.example: It's a matter of catharsis, where I say the most horrible things I<< can>> think of.

modes.label: Think-of instructions
modes.description: The word think or the comma and dash before it in game-style instructions to think of something.
modes.example: - Ask a friend to<< think>> of one of the colors.

modes.label: Verbs leading to thoughts
modes.description: A verb that leads into the word thoughts or mind.
modes.example: often<< induces>> thoughts of the beginning of summer
